chunks: Yet all of them are not alike. Among the people of the Book is a section upright, who recite the scriptures in the hours of the night and bow in adoration and pray,
ai.seo_question: Who are the upright among the People of the Book according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as referring to the Imams or the faithful among the People of the Book who recognized the truth of Islam, distinguishing them from those who distorted their scriptures. The emphasis on night prayer (Tahajjud) and prostration underscores the spiritual discipline required to maintain fidelity to divine revelation amidst textual alteration. This highlights the continuity of true monotheism and the merit of those who preserved the core message despite external changes.
